made_by: s2/s2loop/reason_video.py: the head-camera film with the trial's reason loop, colour-coded by phase

turns.say: measure the scene before any motion - where the nail stands on the board, how high it sticks out, where the hammer lies and what the words find
ask which grasps the hammer has (own shape, trained or not) in a step of its own, no motion
read both hammer grasps in full and measure the nail head and the hammer's ends pixel by pixel from depth, no motion
dry-run without motion - can the arm reach the palm poses a blow on the nail needs with either grasp, and does a planned line accept a blow speed
dry-run without motion - with the second grasp, how far must the held hammer be turned about the vertical for the hand to stay off the board during the blow
dry-run without motion - how fast a planned straight line of my own may go (rows against distance for three speed limits), as a fallback to the strike skill
ask the capability memory what it holds about the hammer class for grasping and striking, no motion
read the capability memory's rows on striking with the hammer in full, no motion

the whole task before the first motion - grasp the hammer with its own-shape clip, turn it so the hand stays off the board, strike the nail three times at 0.6 m/s, check the nail's height in depth, set the hammer down on free table, c
grasp the hammer by its handle with the own-shape clip (second candidate) and lift it 8 cm, per plan step 1
turns.error: grasp_slip: the object left its place and the hand is seen empty

turns.say: the grasp did not hold - the hand is empty and the hammer lies turned; measure how it lies now, that the nail is untouched, and whether the bound clip can take it as it lies
the policy grasp swept the hammer round and came up empty, so measure without motion whether a scripted grasp across the handle (it now points at the robot) and the blow poses from it are reachable
scan without motion which hand turns let the arm reach a palm-down pose beside the handle where it lies now
check without motion that the blow poses over the nail are reachable from a scripted grasp with the fingers pointing right, and from the bound clip as it would take the hammer now
scan without motion how far a hammer pinched across its handle must be turned about the vertical for the blow poses over the nail to be reachable
the policy grasp failed and the session's one clip is spent, so take the hammer by its handle with the scripted grasp, turn and carry it over the nail and strike with a program of my own

take the hammer by its handle with the scripted grasp, fingers across it to the right, flange low beside it, and lift 8 cm (replan step 1); refused variants cost nothing and the first accepted one runs
turns.error: capture_missed: the fingers carry no grip load after the lift and the rest

turns.say: the scripted grasp closed on nothing; see without motion what of the hammer shows beside the arm and where the handle lies now
move the empty hand aside to the right with one short move so that the head camera sees how the hammer lies after the missed grasp (its handle now shows raised toward the head)
measure from the clean view how the hammer lies now - handle axis and its height along the length, where the head rests against the board, and that nail and board are as before

turns.skill: grasp_scripted (one re-execute, target and palm gap changed; two variants refused at plan time first)
turns.say: scripted grasp again with the one thing changed that the look showed - the handle now stands 2 to 3 cm off the table toward the head, so close the fingers across that raised part where the flange can stand beside it
turns.error: capture_missed: the fingers carry no grip load after the lift and the rest

turns.skill: retreat, move_to_pose with open hand (a first move_to_pose was refused: finger 2.2 mm from unseen space)
turns.say: the second scripted grasp also closed on nothing, so open the empty hand and take it aside to the right in one move to see from a clean view where the hammer and the nail are
from the clean view measure where the hammer came to rest after the second missed grasp and that nail and board stand as at the start
